title: status/1
description: The 200 reply to GET /api/v1/status. An archived Project still answers it. waiting and last_fetched_at become real in Epic 4 (Answers); until then they are 0 and null.

waiting.description: How many sent Answers are waiting to be fetched.

last_fetched_at.description: When Answers were last handed out, UTC, exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ; null if never.

accepted_contracts.description: The contract versions this Portal accepts, as in index.json, for example dashboard/1.
